gates.beats_random: Welch t of the monthly net against random-sign books of the same sizes >= 2.0
gates.bootstrap: the 95% interval of the mean monthly net from 12-month block bootstrap is above 0
gates.costs_x2: mean monthly net > 0 at costs x2 (x1.5 reported)
gates.currencies: at least 60% of the currencies traded are net positive
gates.one_month_late: mean monthly net > 0 with every signal one month old
gates.t: monthly net t over 1975-1989 >= the registry threshold over every earlier FX test (never below 3.0)
gates.top_year: no calendar year above 50% of the total net

spec.holdout_rule: only if every gate passes: 2017-01 -> 2026-09 (the H.10 2026-09-29 vintage, with EUR added as the seventh currency), opened once as FXT-1-H. Gates: mean monthly net > 0 in a swap-free account, and > 0 at costs x2. A standard account's swaps (BIS policy rates plus a 1.5% a year markup) are reported. The edge registry calls it VALIDATED only at a holdout t of 2.5 or more
spec.question: did the major currencies' own 12-month trends, traded monthly at equal risk, earn a positive net return in 1975-1989, years no test here has read?
